task.description:
Hard gate — validate TEST-DESIGNER output for WF02-obp-ddl-20260817 before TEST-RUNNER executes.

Test specs to validate:
- tests/specs/OBP-01.md
- tests/specs/OBP-02.md
- tests/specs/OBP-03.md
- tests/specs/DDL-03.md

Integration test files to validate:
- tests/integration/obp01_depth_cache_test.zig
- tests/integration/obp02_ingress_refusal_test.zig
- tests/integration/obp03_outbox_overflow_test.zig
- src/platform/ddl_generate.zig (DDL-03 unit tests added inline)

For each requirement, verify:
1. Every MUST-priority AC has at least one runnable integration test (no SkipZigTest on MUST tests without a documented counterpart)
2. No test coverage is deferred — all ACs from OBP-01/02/03/DDL-03 have corresponding TCs
3. Fixtures are isolated — no shared test state across TCs (verified by lint_test_isolation.py)
4. Tests are self-sufficient — each test sets up its own prerequisites
5. Build wiring is correct — test-integration-obp01-depth, test-integration-obp02, test-integration-obp03 targets exist in build.zig

Return PASS only if all 5 checks pass for all 4 requirements.
Return FAIL with specific gaps if any check fails.

result.summary: Test design for OBP-01/OBP-02/OBP-03/DDL-03 validated. Checks 1, 3, 4, 5 pass. Check 2 fails: OBP-02 AC6 implementation substitutes a migration-seed pre-condition check for the required flushRefusalEvents + event-payload integration test. The spec TC explicitly calls gate.flushRefusalEvents() and asserts the emitted row carries tenant/depth/cap; the actual test only queries event_type_registry for the seeded row. Two MINOR naming discrepancies also noted.

issues.description: TC-OBP-02-AC6-ingress-refused-event only verifies that the EXECUTION_INGRESS_REFUSED row exists in event_type_registry (migration seed). The spec TC requires: (a) push a RefusalEvent to a RefusalEventQueue, (b) call gate.flushRefusalEvents(allocator, pool, queue, config), (c) assert one row in the event log with event_type = EXECUTION_INGRESS_REFUSED and payload containing tenant_schema, depth=50000, cap=50000. The implemented test passes even if flushRefusalEvents is completely broken. AC6 behavior is effectively untested.

Spec maps AC5 to test name 'obp02: stale cache - also returns 429' but the unit test in src/api/middleware/outbox_cap.zig is named 'obp02: stale cache - returns 429 (fail-closed)'. Functional coverage is equivalent; names differ. Spec should be updated to match the implementation name.

Spec TC for AC2 describes a stub conn tracking exec() calls across 1000 readCached iterations. The actual readCached() signature takes no conn parameter (lockless in-memory read), so there is no conn to stub. The existing tests provide structurally equivalent proof that no count(*) can be issued. Spec TC description is outdated relative to the implementation; spec should be updated.

result.next_action: Route back to TEST-DESIGNER (step 03) for rework: fix OBP-02 AC6 test to call flushRefusalEvents with a real RefusalEventQueue and assert the emitted event payload (event_type, tenant_schema, depth, cap), then re-submit for re-validation. Also update spec for AC5 name and AC2 TC description (MINOR).
